I Built an Interactive 3D Wireframe Cube with Sliders in Desmos

In this Desmos 3D Masterclass, we explore 3D Wireframe & Mesh Engines using pure multivariable calculus and linear algebra inside the Desmos Graphing Calculator.

📐 Mathematical Architecture:
- Core Formula: V_i \in \{-1, 1\}^3, \quad E_{ij} = (1 - t)V_i + t V_j \quad (t \in [0, 1])
- Concepts: Polyhedral Vertices, Edge Connectivity Matrices, Homogeneous Coordinates
- Pedagogical Lesson: A cube consists of 8 vertices and 12 connecting edges. Graphing it in Desmos requires parametric line interpolation between adjacent vertices followed by 3D rotation matrix multiplication.
